programs.name: suascii
programs.purpose: Convert SU traces to ASCII, with options for headers, sample values, columns, and coordinate triples.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUASCII - print non zero header values and data in various formats

params.name: bare
params.description: Output mode: 0 prints nonzero headers and data; 1 data only; 2 headers only; 3 CSV columns; 4 tab-delimited columns; 5 x, sample coordinate, and value triples. Takes precedence over option.

params.name: option
params.description: Alias for bare, read only when bare is absent.

params.name: index
params.description: For bare=4, a nonzero value includes a time or depth coordinate column.

params.name: ntr
params.description: Maximum number of traces buffered and printed for bare=3 or bare=4; must be positive even for other modes.

params.name: key
params.description: For bare=5, header keyword supplying the x coordinate; when absent, coordinates use the first trace's f2 and d2.

params.name: sep
params.description: For bare=5, an optional line printed after each trace.

params.name: verbose
params.description: A nonzero value reports trace and sampling information to standard error.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: from the first trace's dt header for seismic data or d1 header for nonseismic data
params.description: Sampling interval fallback, read only when the corresponding first-trace header is zero; the program errors if neither supplies a nonzero value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sampling coordinates mix float arithmetic with double constants before assignment to float; formatted output can expose rounding and platform-dependent floating-point formatting. The CSV loop uses the last read trace's ns while its buffer is allocated using the first trace's ns, so varying trace lengths can cause out-of-bounds access or use of uninitialized data.
programs.difficulty_reason: CSV and tab-delimited modes buffer multiple traces and transpose their samples into output columns.

test_cases.description: Print headers and samples in the default format.
Print samples only using the option alias.
Print a limited number of traces as CSV columns.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=4 | suascii bare=3 ntr=2

test_cases.description: Print tab-delimited samples with the time index.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=3 | suascii bare=4 ntr=3 index=1
